## Highlights

- Add source-IP recurrence buckets and Top 3/Top 10 detection-event concentration for both source IPs and destination port/protocol pairs.
- Compare observed sources and destinations with explicit prior lookback windows, and show when missing sample days limit that comparison.
- Show Top 10 ranking entry, retention, and movement against the preceding comparable period. Suppress movement claims when current or previous sample coverage is insufficient.
- Add a short deterministic summary above the detailed weekly, monthly, preview, and range reports. Detailed counts and coverage remain visible below it.

## Upgrade notes

There is no configuration, RouterOS, collector, or SQLite schema change from `v0.1.3`; SQLite `user_version` remains `6`. Existing daily detection aggregates are reused without backfilling missing historical events. Report output intentionally gains new sections. Detection counts remain observed events, not packets or confirmed attacks.

Stop the running process before updating the code or container image, retain the SQLite database and private environment file, and restart. Back up the database before deployment. Rolling back to `v0.1.3` requires no database migration for this release.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Raposo93/mikrotik-report/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4
